'''Craghowler''' is an [[Alpha enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|Craghowlers are the dominant members of rockhowler communities. These beasts will fight each other countless times before the strongest champion emerges as the leading craghowler. There is no question that such individuals have mastered combat in ways that their kin could only dream of.}}
